subject.title: San Diego County Board of Supervisors, District 5

text: Our County was known as one of the best-managed and secure counties in America. Today, families and small businesses feel the strain of rising costs, bureaucratic waste, and policies disconnected from everyday life.
I’m running for the County Board of Supervisors to restore accountability, focus on our core responsibilities, and improve our quality of life.
I led the fight to stop SANDAG’s mileage tax, protecting families and commuters from thousands in new costs. I will oppose every tax hike the county tries to impose on you!

As San Marcos Mayor, I launched a government efficiency initiative identifying and eliminating more than $1 million in waste. I’ll demand audits of every county program. Every dollar lost to fraud or waste takes away from services for people who need help.
I’ll fight to defend local control on housing decisions so we can hold developers accountable to protect the quality of your neighborhood and provide proper infrastructure to support projects.

I’m co-chairing the CA Voter ID Initiative campaign because a super-majority of Democratic, Republican and Independent voters support this bipartisan solution to restore trust and confidence in our elections.
To get results, I’ll work with everyone to build consensus. People first, not politics.

text: Proudly Endorsed by Congressman Mike Levin and US Senator Adam Schiff
Kyle Krahel is a lifelong Oceanside resident running for County Supervisor to deliver practical solutions on affordability, homelessness, public safety, and opportunity.

As Deputy Chief of Staff to Congressman Levin, Kyle helped secure federal resources for wildfire prevention, coastal protection, veterans’ services, and infrastructure improvements that strengthen North County communities. He works every day to help residents navigate government and solve real problems.

In the private sector, Kyle serves as Managing Director of a commercial property management firm, overseeing operations, budgets, and local employees. He understands the pressures facing working families and small businesses as costs rise.
Kyle previously served on the Oceanside Planning Commission, promoting responsible development of housing we all can afford while protecting open space and parks.

As Supervisor, Kyle will focus on lowering costs of gas, groceries, and housing for San Diegans. He will tackle homelessness with compassion and accountability, strengthen public safety, and protect our environment.
Kyle Krahel is committed to thoughtful, balanced leadership that delivers results for District 5 families.
